title: Retinue - public-facing status
text:
Measured live via gh at 2026-08-07 19:40:00 UTC - one stamp for all five cards. Scope: five public repos; one org repo is private.

Since 08-06 19:30 UTC: he merged #88 (reviewed clean first) and #89 (merged too fast to review - bet-5 gap), opened #84 (reviewed, no reply, 9 h). My own #85, #87 unanswered. #71, #79 unchanged.

GitHub Pages isn't serving these updates: build queued 08-06 13:44 UTC errored/stuck (1 d 6 h). Disk/origin/main fresh; served still 08-05 19:20 UTC - known, escalated delivery fault, not a regeneration defect. This job regenerates daily; a wake-up only checks served against a 26 h bound.

0 stars/forks/watchers/discussions since 07-18 (20 d). Traffic (retinue, 14 d): 13 uniques, 134 views.

62 issues, 58 open - retinue 44(43), chamber 7(5), deployment 1, .github 1, qlever-dir 9(8, 1 PR). Filed by me: 50/62. Desk: most over a week old, oldest chamber#1 at 19 d 21 h.
